title: Meter card shows "grace Ns" countdown chips for healthy classes (armed-full grace rendered as an active countdown)
evidence:
app/render/health.odin:78: "		if health.grace[c].grace_left > 0 {"
app/render/health.odin:86: "			continue // healthy + no countdown — no chip (zero extra pixels)"
core/health.odin:151: "		// the grace cell ARMS FULL on the class's first demand (the prototype's"
core/health.odin:157: "		append(&h.grace, Grace_Cell{grace_left = full})"
demos/health_win.dem:12-13: "# tick 3000 (150 s) — exactly. No breach, no grace, no crisis (AC-E13 rides / # along — a healthy within-capacity topology stays silent):"
detail: Spec: the card shows "per-class grace countdowns" and a countdown starts on breach ENTER. health_ensure arms grace_left FULL on first demand, so every demand-bearing class renders "grace 20s" from tick 1 while healthy — contradicting the code's own "healthy + no countdown — no chip" comment and the win demo's "No breach, no grace" claim.
recommended_fix: Render the grace chip only while a countdown actually runs (breach latch true AND grace_left > 0); an armed-but-idle grace cell draws no chip.

title: health_lose.dem never shows the crisis banner the spec's goldens line lists for the lose surface
evidence:
spec-4-3-network-health.md:131-132: "path — the full lose surface: crisis banner + draining meter + the empty-meter / terminal frame). Both carry T1 + T2 of the win/lose frames."
demos/health_lose.dem:8-9: "# barrier freezes the run (E17 — one terminal event). The death precedes the / # surge window (1200), so there is no crisis banner — the lose surface is the"
detail: The spec's goldens constraint lists "crisis banner + draining meter + the empty-meter terminal frame" as health_lose.dem's surface; the blessed demo explicitly states "there is no crisis banner". The change log documents the pre-surge death but the goldens line was never amended.
recommended_fix: Amend the spec's goldens line to match the blessed demo (death precedes the surge window, per change-log item 1), or add a mid-surge lose capture.
